rule: The configuration structure each tactic elaborates its options into (Lean.Elab.Tactic.elabSimpConfig: simp and simpa -> Lean.Meta.Simp.Config, simp_all -> Lean.Meta.Simp.ConfigCtx; grind -> Lean.Grind.Config) is enumerated by simp_config_query.lean on every installed core toolchain: every field (flattened, Lean's declaration order, nothing filtered by name) with its type and default. toggles: every Bool field toggled away from its default, singly, in the option form +f (default false) / -f (default true) when every toolchain accepts it, else the config form (config := { f := v }) when every toolchain accepts that; kept only when the field has the same default on every toolchain and the setting is accepted on the goal True and does not close the goal False (a setting that closes False closes goals without a proof) on every toolchain; ordered by declaration order (the relative order agrees on every toolchain). No field is selected by name. harness/hb_tool_candidates.py offers a call each toggle of its tactic that the call does not already set, singly and in table order (simp_config, grind_config).
query: python3 harness/tools/tables/gen_simp_config.py: lean harness/tools/tables/simp_config_query.lean (import Lean) on every installed core toolchain

dropped.reason: a toolchain rejects both spellings or one closes False
